title: Lovely Greek Ovoli Mushroom Keftedes
description: A funky, tender, and cozy Greek dish featuring ovoli mushrooms, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian meal. This dish combines the earthy flavor of mushrooms with the brightness of Greek herbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onion and garlic, chopped mushrooms, crumbly feta cheese, breadcrumbs, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the keftedes in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, flipping them halfway through.
Serve the keftedes hot, garnished with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon juice.
